messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — Incident INC-202603-5XX
incidentbot: policy=inference-gateway-error-rate, condition=5xx_rate>2% for 5m, region=us-west1, current=8.7%, top_endpoints=[/v1/generate,/v1/stream]
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-202603 created and routed to rotation (service=inference-gateway)
pagerduty: Assigned to mike_oncall
mike_oncall: Acked. I'm on it. @sre_robin @eng_jules please join. Any immediate customer reports?
sre_robin: No direct customer pages in support yet, but synthetic monitors show elevated 502/504s. Logs show many "upstream reset by peer" from kproxy -> model-backends.
eng_jules: Looking at kproxy logs now. Repro: multiple concurrent requests hit a model host and we see repeated connection resets.
eng_jules: quick grep:
```
kproxy[pid=4212] ERROR upstream reset by peer: conn_id=0x3f7a, host=model-enc-12a
```
ops_lee: Scaling action queued. Requesting +2 workers in us-west1 (dedicated pool). Kicking off instance pool scale now.
mike_oncall: Running light checks: curl https://inference-usw1.internal/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' -> HTTP/1.1 502
sre_robin: KPI snapshot: 5m window: total requests=1.2M, 5xx=104k (8.7%). P95 latency up 40%.
eng_jules: Hypothesis: model backend OOM/eviction under bursty prompt sizes; eviction correlates with kworker restarts in the same window.
eng_jules: Can we route a fraction of traffic to model-quant/medium as fallback? It has lower mem but acceptable perf.
mike_oncall: Initiating traffic diversion: route 20% of gen traffic to fallback pool (model-quant-medium) and enable stricter per-client concurrency limits. Making the change in router console now.
ops_lee: Scale +2 successful, new instances booting and warming. Warmup logs show model load OK but warmup cache not yet populated.
sre_robin: Impact assessment: ~12% of customer requests hit failure state (errors concentrated on heavy prompt customers). We have 3 customers with elevated error rates >15% (account ids masked). No broad customer-facing outage reported yet.
eng_jules: Pushed temporary circuit-breaker in frontend to reduce backend concurrency to 8 per-host. Patch:
```
router.conf: backend_max_concurrency=8
```
mike_oncall: Observing metrics after diversion + scale + concurrency change...
incidentbot: Metrics update (1m): 5xx dropped from 8.7% -> 3.1%, p95 latency starting to recover.
eng_jules: CPU on model hosts still spiky but within limits. KV cache hit-rate low during warmup.
ops_lee: Warmup complete on 2 new nodes, serving traffic. Continuing to monitor.
sre_robin: Confirming customer impact: Support triage reached out to top-3 affected customers; they saw intermittent 502s over last 20 minutes. No severity-1 SLO breaches yet.
mike_oncall: Good. Plan: keep diversion +scales for 30m, watch for reversion. If stable <1.5% 5xx for 10m, rollback fallback and remove circuit-breaker.
eng_jules: I'll follow up with model team to check memory tuning and OOM logs for permanent fix. Filing a post-incident ticket: CORE-3145.
ops_lee: Noted. I'll leave autoscaler disabled for that pool while we validate to avoid thrash.
pagerduty: Incident INC-202603 acknowledged by mike_oncall
mike_oncall: Thanks all. Quick note for handoff: @sre_robin will take on-monitoring for the next hour, eng_jules will follow remediation, ops_lee will keep scaling/infra on standby. I'll hand off at 17:40 PT.
sre_robin: Taking monitoring handoff. Will escalate immediately if >2% 5xx for 5m.
incidentbot: :white_check_mark: Update: 5xx at 5m=1.2% after 25m. Status=stabilizing.
eng_jules: Created CORE-3145 with runbook links and suggested fixes (model memory cap, kv cache prewarm). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx
mike_oncall: Marking incident as mitigated. Will leave PagerDuty incident open for postmortem and close after runbook verification.
pagerduty: Incident INC-202603 marked as mitigated by mike_oncall
ops_lee: Leaving scaled nodes up for observation. Will auto-scale down after 2h if stable.
sre_robin: Logged customer outreach notes in CRM. No follow-up SLA credits recommended at this time.
mike_oncall: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I’ll start the postmortem doc and include timeline + dashboards. Handoff complete.
pagerduty: Incident INC-202603 status=resolved by automation (condition: mitigated & no re-alert for 30m)
incidentbot: :information_source: Thread will remain pinned to the incident channel for 24h for postmortem comments."
